question: To which form of the speech goddess does the practitioner take refuge?
premises: The goddess is described as prosperous and proud in youth
The goddess is described as letter-bodied
The practitioner takes refuge in the speech goddess
inference: The practitioner takes refuge in Vāgīśvarī, who is prosperous, youth-proud, and embodied in letters
plain_english: I take refuge in Vāgīśvarī, prosperous, proud in her youth, and embodied in letters.
